{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any immediate issues
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Unique customer_segment values:", df['customer_segment'].unique().tolist())
print("Unique channel values:", df['channel'].unique().tolist())
print("Unique status values:", df['status'].unique().tolist())
print("Unique converted values:", df['converted'].unique().tolist())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of customer_age == -1:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue for QA and negative values
print("Number of revenue == '999999.99'", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())
print("Number of negative revenue values:", (df['revenue'].astype(float) < 0).sum())

# Check if there are any rows with status == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Summary of premises
premises_verified = {
    'customer_segment_has_new': 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(),
    'channel_has_paid_search': 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(),
    'status_has_completed': 'completed' in df['status'].unique(),
    'no_other_customer_segments': len(df['customer_segment'].unique()) == 3,
    'no_qa_orders': (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 6,
    'no_negative_revenue': (df['revenue'].astype(float) < 0).sum() == 0,
    'customer_age_sentinel_works': (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() == 108,
    'converted_is_binary': set(df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1},
    'channel_not_randomized': False  # this is a fact but not a premise to check
}

premises_verified"}
